subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below represents the expenditure of a country on various sports during 2015. Study the pie chart and answer the question that follows.

Note: the pie chart is not drawn to scale. The data does not represent the actual numbers. It has been created only for mathematical exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9b6239f0ff5eb5cd6a2243b3d23deb20778d78188f03309dffc1b90ae737e9d.png] 

In 2015, there was an increase of 50% and 25% of expenditure on Cricket and Other Sports, respectively, compared to the previous year. What was the ratio of the expenditure on Cricket to that on Other Sports in 2014?
solution:
Calculation:

In 2014,

Share of Other Sports = 59 ÷ (1 + {25 over 100}) = 47.2° 

Share of Cricket = 85 ÷ (1 + {50 over 100}) ≈ 56.67°

Hence, ratio = 56.67 : 47.2 = 425 : 354

**∴ 425 : 354 was the ratio of the expenditure on Cricket to that on Other Sports in 2014.**
